stages.name: stage-01-base
stages.purpose: Initial publication with true GPS gap, evidence hole, impossible jump and midnight missing interval.

stages.name: stage-02-late-midnight-gap-fill
stages.purpose: Late data fills midnight gap and forces cross-day activity revision + atomic publication.

stages.name: stage-03-overlap-better-quality
stages.purpose: New Batch overlaps existing timestamps with better quality to test same-second reducer and generation.

stages.name: stage-04-replay-and-conflict
stages.purpose: Verify replay/conflict do not increment input_generation.
